detail.longDescription: 🧠 NEW: Two people with # paralysis used a single # brain implant to control a virtual avatar’s # speech and # gestures at once. The device, 253 electrodes resting on the sensorimotor cortex, decoded attempted phrases and movements in real time, mapping them to a personalized onscreen figure. Accuracy reached 85% for gestures and 75% for phrases, with one participant at 100%. 👉 https://www. smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/ this-brain-implant-allows-people-with-paralysis-to-speak-and-gesture-at-the-same-time-via-a-mind-controlled-virtual-avatar-180989604/ # neuroscience # medicine # technology # tech # implants # avatars # science # research # accessibility # education
